articles.title: Polanski vows to stay on as Green leader as criticism mounts
articles.description: Jewish Greens' leader has said Polanski should resign in the wake of a Zionism row and by-election defeat.

articles.title: Polanski challenged over whether he thinks Israel has right to exist
articles.description: The Green Party leader defends his decision to miss a debate on a controversial motion about Zionism which was passed by party members.

articles.title: France promises 3,000 extra teachers in first step to calm student protests
articles.description: Education minister Edouard Geffray makes the offer after another day of sometimes violent demonstrations by high-school students.

articles.title: Firing squad execution of man who killed 13 soldiers to be livestreamed, Pentagon says
articles.description: Pete Hegseth says the execution will be public, but a legal expert says the "unprecedented" decision is on "uncertain legal terrain".
